# Vertical Layout

A layout component for organizing content with header, main content, and footer sections.

## When to Use

- Page-level layout structure
- Fixed header/footer with scrollable content
- Standard application shell

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `VerticalLayout` | Main container |
| `VerticalLayoutHeader` | Fixed header area |
| `VerticalLayoutContent` | Scrollable main content |
| `VerticalLayoutFooter` | Fixed footer area |

For code examples and API details, use the Jumpstart MCP tools:
- `get-jumpstart-components-apis` with `["VerticalLayout"]`
- `get-jumpstart-components-examples` with `["VerticalLayout"]`
